basic_profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Java · Spring Boot · GenAI | Visa Payments & Sabre Travel | FinTech
basic_profile.name: Agrim Maheshwari
basic_profile.summary:
Senior Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building and scaling high-availability, production-grade backend systems using Java and Spring Boot for business-critical platforms in payments, finance, and travel domains.

Currently working with Visa’s Campaign Management Systems through Accenture, where I contribute to backend services that operate at enterprise scale with strict reliability, availability, and performance requirements. My work has directly supported 99.9% uptime, reduced incident response time by ~40%, and improved system readiness through failover and resilience-focused designs.

I specialize in microservices-based architectures, RESTful APIs, and backend automation, with hands-on experience improving system stability, observability, and time-to-market. I’ve delivered reusable backend components and templates that enabled faster rollout of global campaigns with reduced manual effort.

Previously at Infosys, I worked on large-scale platforms for Sabre Corporation, designing and optimizing backend services for booking, subscriptions, and itinerary management—cutting API latency by ~25% and reducing production defects by ~30% through better testing and code quality practices.

Certified AWS Cloud Practitioner, I bring a product mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, QA, and product teams in Agile environments. I’m interested in backend roles where scale, reliability, and system design are core to the problem being solved.
